notes: Added a "Sent history (last 30)" section to the Telegram Queue page - a plain, always-current, newest-first record of what's actually gone out to the channel, separate from the review queue above it (which mixes pending/rejected/sent together sorted by scheduled time, not recency). Same underlying data the AI already reads for its own "don't repeat this" context, now easy to browse in the panel too, with its own Details/Delete actions.
